optimization.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_work_orders_updated_at_id ON public.work_orders USING btree (updated_at, id)

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: Data Platform Alembic initially read the application revision from a shared version table and could not resolve it in its own history.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Use data_platform_alembic_version independently from the application alembic_version table.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: Application current/head/check passed at 20260726_0008; Data Platform current/head, offline full-history render, and isolated PostgreSQL upgrade passed at 20260824_dp0002; expected version-table/index SQL assertions and the broader 42 Data Platform tests passed.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.known_validation_limitation: Data Platform alembic check is unsupported because its raw-SQL migration history intentionally has target_metadata=None; current=head, offline full-history render, a real isolated upgrade, expected SQL assertions, and the broader Data Platform test suite are the validation substitute.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: An absolute Windows extraction object_path was not portable into the Airflow container, and a published object could exist before its audit row was recorded.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Persist a relative object key, resolve it under the current DATA_PLATFORM_DATA_ROOT, and checksum-recover a published object and missing audit record.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: Host/container retries consumed the same immutable bytes; incremental and empty Airflow runs completed without duplicate raw versions.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: A resumed COPY invocation reported only newly loaded rows and omitted chunks committed before the retry.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Derive completion totals from checksum-verified audit.dataset_load_chunks records committed with each COPY/upsert chunk.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: Audit totals reconciled 1000000 baseline and 110000 incremental work-order rows/versions plus dependent chunks.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: The watermark needed protection from stale or concurrent retries and from advancing ahead of committed raw data.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Lock the tuple watermark with FOR UPDATE and advance only to a greater upper tuple in the same transaction as raw COPY and batch status.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: The final watermark version was 3; the immediate empty run preserved the tuple and added zero raw versions.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: Raw-only reconciliation could hide absent or mismatched staging and fact layers.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Require transformed layers by default, equal source/raw-unique/staging/fact counts, and zero fact duplicates.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: All four layers reconciled at 1100000 unique work orders with zero fact duplicates.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: The initial incremental fixture placed updated_at values in the future relative to the evidence window.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Bound new and update timestamps to 2026-08-23 and 2026-08-24, ending update ties at 2026-08-24T04:00:00.010000Z.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: The final watermark stayed inside the benchmark window and the immediate rerun extracted zero rows.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: The closed analytics adapter used UTC date boundaries and could assign records to the wrong Vietnamese date at day boundaries.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Filter on (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date and use the same reporting timezone in the dbt date spine, fact date keys, and marts.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: Adapter coverage in the 42 Data Platform tests and dbt daily-to-fact reconciliation passed; final dbt build passed all 318 nodes.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: dbt attempted to write target and logs inside the read-only project mount in Airflow.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Redirect DBT_TARGET_PATH and DBT_LOG_PATH to writable data/scale/dbt directories.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: dbt run and test passed in both Airflow runs, and generated paths passed gitignore validation.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: The Airflow image did not see the latest DAG edit and the DAG was paused by default.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Bind-mount the live DAG directory and explicitly unpause maintenance_scale_pipeline.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: Incremental and empty DAG runs each succeeded 9 of 9 tasks with zero retries.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: Airflow image dependency resolution was unstable when only the dbt adapter was pinned.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: The image resolved and ran successfully; final dbt parse and build passed.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: The first final DagBag validation invocation was incompatible with the Airflow 3.3 API.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Use the supported Airflow 3.3 DagBag validation invocation.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: DagBag reported zero import errors and exactly nine DAG tasks.

failures_encountered_and_fixes.failure: An auxiliary database snapshot query referenced checkpoint catalog columns from an older PostgreSQL release.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.fix: Use the PostgreSQL 17 catalog and column names for the evidence query.
failures_encountered_and_fixes.validation: The final database/resource snapshot reran successfully without changing benchmark data.

limitations: local synthetic benchmark, not production traffic or company usage
five measured samples after one warmup per query
tickets and inventory were not populated by the scale fixture
synthetic technicians are inactive and have deliberately invalid login-disabled password hashes
RAG and LLM quality were not measured
resource values are local point-in-time and cgroup captures, not production capacity guarantees
